description.from:
Generate cover images when a diagram doesn't make sense and no stock image gets approved. Uses the same four-option picker.

Open decisions for Ryan: which image model and provider, a per-site cost limit, and whether generated images are labelled for readers. Any model or provider choice needs his explicit approval.
description.to:
Generate cover images when a diagram doesn't make sense and no stock image gets approved. Uses the same four-option picker.

Open decisions for Ryan: which image model and provider, and whether generated images are labelled for readers. Any model or provider choice needs his explicit approval.

Out of scope (Ryan 2026-11-05): quotas, usage limits and billing. Cost accounting belongs to the separate billing initiative. This epic only records each generation's model and prompt on the image, which is already part of PPY-7c3f6a.
